title: Support Of A Mixed Strategy
body_html:
Support Of A Mixed Strategy

The support of a mixed strategy $x \in \Delta(I)$ is the set $$ \operatorname{supp}(x)=\{i \in I : x_i>0\}. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 2, Section 2.3] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Support of a mixed strategy.
